title: IRS Enrolled Agent Exam Part 3: Representation, Practices and Procedures
releaseBlockers: the due diligence penalty and some collection figures come from 2026 editions: confirm the amounts that apply in the exam window
description: EA Part 3: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: Circular 230, IRS publications and the Internal Revenue Code
notice: of the Internal Revenue Service, administered by PSI Services. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Internal Revenue Service, its Office of Professional Responsibility, the U.S. Department of the Treasury or PSI Services. It uses Treasury Department Circular No. 230, IRS publications and the Internal Revenue Code, which are works of the U.S. Government; credit: Internal Revenue Service. Rules and amounts are those in force for the 2026-27 testing window (law as amended through 31 December 2025).

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 793 cards against Circular 230, the Internal Revenue Code and the IRS publications they quote, word for word as found by the card checker, and worked every scenario's dates and arithmetic
checks.result: No wrong answers; 7 unsupported claims, 6 ambiguous cards, 3 unclear ones and 40 minor issues were fixed, 3 duplicates removed, and every dollar figure now names its source year and is marked volatile. The due diligence penalty is sourced only for returns filed in 2026, and the cards say so.
